summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-R6 admits no external crate. academic-build-learn links academic-critical-path, academic-curriculum, academic-domain, academic-gap, academic-knowledge-state, academic-repository-classification, serde and thiserror as product edges, and academic-capture, academic-consent, academic-critical-path, academic-domain, academic-freshness, academic-gap, academic-knowledge-state, academic-lecture-document, academic-model-run, academic-policy, academic-repository, academic-repository-analysis, academic-repository-correlation, academic-transcription, academic-untrusted-content, serde_json, tempfile, trybuild and uuid as dev edges, all covered by earlier reviewed receipts, and adds one workspace path package. Nothing links into a product binary that was not already there: the six workspace product edges are path packages this repository already builds, and serde and thiserror were admitted by the phase 1 receipt. Build-time-only additions are zero -- there is no build script, no proc macro beyond serde's and thiserror's, and no code generator.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-build-learn is the P2-R6 boundary: section 20's Build -> Learn mode and section 21's SNU course-to-project mapping. It owns the six input kinds and the normalisation that produces an intent rather than a technology list; the ProjectGoal whose four groups are four types; the reverse path's three stages, each taking the one before it by value; the AND/OR concept requirements, whose OR members are stamped conditional by their branch group's constructor; the six readiness rows and the resolution order that makes them mutually exclusive; the learning item that cannot exist without its executable evidence task and its return-to-project checkpoint, and the four-stage approval chain behind that checkpoint; the plan validator that refuses a study-only plan for four structural absences and no word; the three motivation edges shown in parallel with no route to a sum; and section 21's designed-versus-actual coverage separation with its six mapping statuses. It is a separate package from academic-critical-path because that crate owns what a satisfying set costs and this one owns what a goal decomposes into, and the direction of the edge is what keeps a plan impossible without a solved hypergraph and a hypergraph solvable without a plan.

no_second_vocabulary_note: Section 16.1's AND/OR hypergraph was implemented by P2-N6 and this crate adds none of it again: ArchitectureBranch::hypergraph builds academic_critical_path::Hyperedge values over academic_gap::PrerequisiteEdge members, and ArchitectureBranch::satisfying_sets delegates to academic_critical_path::satisfying_sets, so section 20.2's `concept requirements with AND/OR branches` is that crate's structure and its solver rather than a second one. There is no path length anywhere in this crate. Section 13.1's mastery ladder and section 13.3's freshness bands were implemented by P2-N2 and P2-N3 and are read through P2-N5's four-dimension ConceptState overlay: `충분하고 최근인 evidence` is that overlay's SufficiencyGap list being empty and `stale` is academic_critical_path::is_stale over P2-N3's own band, so this crate has no ladder, no decay, no threshold and no clock. Section 18's three classifications were implemented by P2-R4 and the `규모/조건이 바뀌면` row carries that crate's BenefitContract whole -- its triggers, its TriggerState and its trade-offs -- rather than re-deriving a benefit here; RequirementOrigin is deliberately not serialized, because BenefitContract implements neither Serialize nor Deserialize and giving one a wire form here would publish a value P2-R4 chose not to. Section 8.2's CourseRevision and CourseOffering are P2-U1's and section 8.3's four OfferingStatus values are read and never restated: DesignedCoverage is a projection of CourseRevision::designed_concept_coverage and ActualCoverage is a separate type carrying the syllabus, lecture, assignment or assessment sighting that observed it, with no conversion between the two in either direction. Section 20.2's readiness count is a measurement of the design document in both directions and its two readings are both kept: the reverse-path drawing names five and the result table has six rows, five_readiness_categories_map_exactly requires the five to be an order-preserving injection into the six with the residue pinned, and docs/contracts/build-to-learn.md records the discrepancy. Six input kinds, four checkpoint stages, three motivation labels, four goal keys and six mapping statuses are parsed back out of PERSONAL_ACADEMIC_CS_PROJECT_OS_END_STATE_DESIGN.md at run time the same way.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-critical-path: P2-N6's Hyperedge, EdgeMember, EdgeStanding, SatisfyingSet and satisfying_sets, so section 20.2's AND/OR requirements are section 16.1's hypergraph and its satisfaction answer rather than a second structure and a second solver; is_stale, so `mastery evidence는 있으나 stale` is P2-N3's band read through the predicate that already refuses UNKNOWN as stale; and CostEstimate, so section 21.3's two channel effects are two of that crate's intervals held side by side and folded by nothing.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-curriculum: P2-U1's CourseRevision, CourseOffering and OfferingStatus. Section 21's whole content is that a course is not its title, so the canonical coverage a mapping reads is CourseRevision::designed_concept_coverage and the standing it reads is section 8.3's own enumeration; neither is restated here and no mapping is derived from a CourseTitle.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: EntityId and EntityKind for what a concept requirement is about, CourseId, OfferingId and EvidenceId for what a coverage claim binds, and MasteryLevel and FreshnessBand for the two readings a readiness finding carries. Naming those rather than declaring a second vocabulary is what makes a planned concept the same entity the ledger holds.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-gap: P2-N5's PrerequisiteEdge, so a hyperedge member passed that crate's admission and therefore P2-C4's prerequisite_descriptor and this crate holds no predicate allowlist; gap_bearing, so section 7.4's `지나치게 큰 "Database"는 Field/cluster` refuses a whole-field requirement at the point it is stated rather than at the point advice is printed; and ConceptState, whose four-dimension overlay is the whole evidence half of the readiness comparison.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-knowledge-state: P2-N2's SufficiencyGap, reached through P2-N5's overlay, which is what `충분하고 최근인 evidence` means. The crate compares the list against empty and computes no sufficiency of its own.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-repository-classification: P2-R4's BenefitContract, carried whole by RequirementOrigin::BenefitTrigger so the `trigger 기반 benefit` row shows the trigger and the trade-off that crate published rather than a re-derivation. There is no route in this crate from repository bytes to a classification, and no fourth classification is declared.

dev_workspace_dependencies.trybuild: The compile-fail suite. Section 20's and section 21's separations are types, and the eight cases under crates/build-learn/tests/compile_fail assert that each refusal is a program that does not compile with a committed diagnostic -- a goal stated before its success conditions, a technology list built from a list of names, a branch derived before the decomposition, an OR member published unconditionally, a learning item with no evidence task, a selection approved before the simulation, two motivation labels added together, and a current-course support claim assembled field by field.
dev_workspace_dependencies.uuid: Deterministic UUIDv7-shaped fixture identities, derived from a digest of the fixture's name rather than from a clock. The same helper P2-N2's, P2-N5's, P2-N6's and P2-X5's suites use.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-build-learn is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns sections 20 and 21, whose whole content is that a goal is normalised into observable success conditions and open choices before any technology is named. Six separations hold that rather than a sentence. Criteria precede technology: SuccessCriteria::of returns None for an empty list, ProjectGoal::state takes one by value, TechnologySlate::under is the only producer of a technology list and it takes a ProjectGoal, and the whole set of public functions returning one is compared against exactly that producer. Responsibilities precede the branch: ResponsibilityDecomposition::decompose takes a ProjectGoal by value and ArchitectureBranch::of takes a decomposition by value, so the arrow in the reverse-path drawing is the ownership of a value and a branch stated first is a program that does not compile. An OR member is conditional by construction: BranchGroup::of stamps the decision and the alternative onto every member it is given, no public constructor of a ConceptRequirement takes a RequirementCondition, and the field is private -- and the branch refuses a decision the goal did not leave open, an alternative that decision does not offer, a decision with fewer than two branches, and an open decision with no branch at all. A learning item needs both halves: LearningItem::plan takes an EvidenceTask and a ReturnCheckpoint by value, the checkpoint holds a SelectionApproved, and each of the four approval stages takes the one before it by value, so `선택 승인` before `최소 simulation test` has no value of the right type. A study-only plan is refused structurally: the validator reads four absences -- no implementation step, a success criterion no implementation step moves toward, a return checkpoint naming a step the plan does not have, and one that returns to more studying -- and reads no word at all, which a_fluent_lecture_list_plan_fails_validation measures by driving a plan spelled with none of the design document's words and observing the same defect set. And the three motivation edges are never summed: MotivationDisplay hands out one row per label with its own reason, Motivation implements no arithmetic and holds no numeric payload, the whole set of public signatures naming a motivation type and returning a number is compared against the empty set with each half shown separately non-empty, and the whole set of 55 impl headers is pinned in both directions and required to name no folding trait for any type pair at all -- which is the bypass class P2-Y3 measured and P2-X5 found still open elsewhere, invisible to every public-function sweep because a trait impl declares no pub fn. Its dependency set is minimal and the edges it does not have are the point: no academic-store, so a plan cannot reach the canonical writer and this task adds no migration; no academic-worker and no academic-egress-boundary, so nothing in its closure can launch a process or stage a payload; no academic-model-run as a product edge, so nothing here can call a model.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, opens no file, reads no clock, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It spells no std::fs name at all: every goal, snapshot identity, overlay, revision, offering and coverage sighting arrives as an argument, the way P2-R3's documents, P2-R4's chains and P2-N6's estimates do. the_build_learn_crate_touches_no_file_and_no_socket in crates/build-learn/tests/build_learn_scans.rs compares the whole set of its use items against a 35-entry inventory, the whole set of the two-segment paths it reaches through a crate root -- five, all of them types of academic-critical-path, academic-gap or thiserror -- and the whole set of the macros it invokes -- one, matches -- against pinned inventories in both directions, and runs a whole-identifier pass for nineteen filesystem, clock, process and transport constructs over every file of the package, tests included, with Instant, SystemTime and a bare now among them; the one file skipped is academic-gap's fixture module included by #[path], which opens a tempfile and is swept by that crate's own suite. every_public_signature_is_in_the_inventory compares all 130 public signatures against a pinned inventory in both directions; every_impl_header_in_this_crate_is_in_the_inventory compares all 55 impl headers the same way, refuses fifteen folding traits over the whole inventory, and pins the eight conversions this crate does implement -- all of them serde round trips of its two text wrappers and its one non-empty collection -- and requires none of them to name an integral or floating-point type; and no_signature_folds_the_motivation_edges additionally compares the whole set of declared fields against having any floating-point member and against having more than one integral member. libc reaches its link closure through academic-domain and through academic-policy's bundled SQLite by way of academic-curriculum and academic-repository-classification, the same way it reaches every other pure crate above those; the crate spells no socket construct, which is why its SOCKET_ALLOWANCE entry is absent rather than empty. Every goal, overlay, branch, plan, revision and offering in its test tree is synthetic and built in process; no real repository is read, no version-control command is run, and no network call is made.
